judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usageAggregation.acceptance.test.ts`), completely failing to modify the actual production code in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage, the candidate's own newly added tests will fail on `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature (to `totalUsage`) or add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry mentioned in the acceptance criteria. While the test cases and spec edit are aligned with the ticket's goals, the core implementation is entirely missing.
